media.title: Le plus petit baiser — Salabert 3382, listening reference
media.description: Listening reference for “Le plus petit baiser” sung by Henri Garat with the orchestra conducted by Kaper. The upload identifies the disc as Salabert 3382 of 3 October 1933, the pressing already documented here from the Bibliothèque nationale de France.
